summary: The customer called because they noticed an unexpected bank charge after canceling an internet setup order. The agent checked the account using the phone number, explained that the system needed time to process the refund, and confirmed that the 45-dinar refund would be credited automatically within 3 to 5 business days. The customer was satisfied and the call ended politely.

evidence.text: المبلغ وقدره 45 دينار رح ينزل بحسابك خلال 3 لـ 5 أيام عمل.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Refund of 45 dinars will be credited to the customer's account within 3 to 5 business days.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, respectful, and professional tone throughout the call.
The agent was understanding and reassuring when the customer was confused or frustrated.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully addressed the customer's issue regarding the unexpected charge and clarified the refund process.
